domain.periodic_cover: The phase box [-4,4]^7 contains [-pi,pi]^7. All 14 coefficient targets are 2pi-periodic in q or constant (joint H derivatives). This bounds coefficient functions; it changes no physical joint limit.
domain.conditional_T_and_K_coverage: Any feasible tightened plan has |vp|+chi_v+delta_v<=vmax, hence its T velocities are physical and chi_v<=vmax. Markov bounds on every degree-five span plus Lambda*vmax cover qr_ddot in K. A failing tightened-speed screen never establishes coverage or planner feasibility.
domain.Markov_derivation: On [-1,1], ||p2||<=200||p|| and ||p3||<=840||p|| for degree5. Rescale a span and center q: ap<=400*width/L^2; jerk<=3360*width/L^3.
domain.training_anchors: Four previously measured v4 C4 starts and original physical midpoint, each a=0; included before tests, not chosen for success.
